title: The cardigan
logline: The librarian's cardigan on the chair, close. A pen in the pocket. A pencil-stub. The person who wrote '(finch)' on the box, drawn as her sweater.

panels.composition: Close on a wooden chair's back with a gray cardigan hung over it: a pen in the breast pocket, a pencil stub, a folded slip of paper. The reading-room lamp's light on the wool. No one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a gray cardigan hanging on a wooden chair's back with a pen and a pencil stub in its pocket under a green lamp's light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
